name: Kusairo no Hitomi
source:
People have feared darkness from ancient times, so they exposed themselves to the light. To protect themselves they started using armors and swords and invented ethics to get rid of anxieties. Cthulhu myths materialize in this darkness and assault the girls full of primordial terror.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
自古以来，人类便畏惧黑暗，因而投身光明。为了保护自己，他们披上铠甲、拿起刀剑，又创立伦理道德，试图摆脱不安。然而，克苏鲁神话在这片黑暗中化为现实，裹挟着原初的恐惧，向女孩们袭来。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
